editorial:
Imagine walking into a cozy old antique shop and finding a world-class cake shop hidden inside. That is exactly what happens here. You will meet Jin-hyeok, who has a big dream, and Seon-woo, a pastry genius who has been secretly in love with him since high school. The movie feels like a warm hug, mixing funny moments with sweet romance. You also get a great supporting cast, like a tough ex-boxer and a dramatic French ex-boyfriend, which keeps the energy high and the laughs coming. It is a lighthearted story about finding where you belong and following your heart, even when things get messy.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the leads and the beautiful shots of the desserts. The pacing is smooth, though some of the romantic drama might feel a bit slow if you are looking for heavy action. If you love stories about food and love, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a lot of jealousy and mixed signals, Seon-woo and Jin-hyeok finally admit their true feelings for each other. They decide to run the cake shop together as partners in both business and love. The other characters also find peace with their own heartbreaks. It ends on a high note with the shop becoming a success, proving that their passion for baking and each other was the secret ingredient all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and baking movies.
